bee.lore.legendary: Danced the waggle dance so well that the whole hive flew to the ice-cream van instead of the clover. The van now has a queue of very sticky customers.
bee.lore.epic: Swarmed into the bakery and tasted every doughnut through the glass. The baker now sells them as pre-licked.

beetle.lore.epic: Marched a rhinoceros-beetle army under the patio and lifted every paving stone half a centimetre. The garden table now wobbles on purpose.

i_isopod.lore.rare: Sucked up so much damp from the cellar floor that the house dried out. The plants upstairs have asked it to move back.
i_isopod.lore.legendary: Rolled itself up so tightly that an elephant stood on it by mistake. The elephant apologised first.

i_lacewing.lore.legendary: Laid each of its eggs on a tiny silk stalk, and a whole orchard of aphids woke up to a forest of lollipops that bite.
i_lacewing.lore.epic: Gathered in the garden shed for winter with a thousand cousins and turned pink-brown together. The gardener thinks the shed has gone rusty.

i_leaf_beetle.lore.epic: Glittered on every bean leaf at once, and the allotment looked so posh that the neighbours started dressing up to water it.

i_leafhopper.lore.epic: Sucked so much sap from the rose bush that it rained sticky drops on the car below for a week. The car wash has blamed the clouds.
i_leafhopper.lore.rare: Sings to its friends by buzzing through the plant stem, so the tomato plant hums all afternoon and the gardener checks it for batteries.

i_long_horned_beetle.lore.epic: Its long antennae caught every washing line in the garden at once, so it flew off wearing three socks and a tea towel.

i_mantis.lore.legendary: Turned its head right round at a football match and watched both goals at once. The referee has asked it to stop helping.

i_tiger_beetle.lore.epic: Dug a burrow in the sand dune and waited at the door with its jaws open. The ants now use a different dune.

i_trilobite.lore.legendary: Survived three of the biggest disasters in Earth history by hiding in mud, then got found by a five-year-old with a toy spade.

butterfly.lore.epic: Rested on a washing line with a million cousins, and the neighbours thought someone had hung out a stained-glass window.

i_lycaenid.lore.legendary: Was so small and so blue that a bride wore it as a brooch all through the wedding. It left during the speeches.

x_moth_insect.lore.epic: Laid its eggs in the wardrobe, and by spring every jumper in the house had air conditioning.

i_ringlet.lore.legendary: Kept flying through a thunderstorm that grounded every other butterfly, and landed at the picnic before the sandwiches got wet.

i_sulphur_butterfly.lore.legendary: Sat on a yellow taxi for so long that it got driven across the whole city. It got off exactly at the flower market.

caterpillar.lore.epic: Hung a silk safety line from every cabbage in the patch, and the gardener got tangled up like a fly.
caterpillar.lore.rare: Puffed up its fake eye-spots at a blackbird, which flew off thinking it had met a tiny snake.

x_centipede_insect.lore.legendary: Raced every spider in the cellar on all its legs at once, and won before the spiders had found their own feet.

x_earthworm.lore.epic: Came up with a million cousins after a storm, and the football pitch was cancelled because the grass was wiggling.

x_leech.lore.epic: Stretched itself across the whole stream like a rubber band, and the ducklings used it as a bridge.

x_millipede.lore.epic: Curled up in the porch shoes with a thousand cousins, and every boot in the house now smells faintly of almonds.

i_american_lobster.lore.epic: Moulted its whole shell in one piece and left it on the pier. The fisherman spent an hour trying to catch it.

crab.lore.epic: Dug a burrow under every sandcastle on the beach at once, and the whole beach sank half a metre with a sigh.

i_fiddler_crab.lore.legendary: Grew its big claw so heavy that it fell over sideways, then grew a new one on the other side out of spite.
i_fiddler_crab.lore.rare: Dug a burrow so deep in the mud that it built a little chimney of sand balls on top. The tide knocks it down every day.

i_hermit_crab.lore.epic: Moved into a lost rubber boot and paraded it along the shore. The seagulls followed, waiting for the other boot.
i_hermit_crab.lore.legendary: Swapped shells so many times that it once lived in a seashell from every beach on the coast, and still says the first one was best.

dragonfly.lore.epic: Patrolled the whole campsite at sunset, and the campers could finally eat outdoors without a single mosquito.
dragonfly.lore.legendary: Flew backwards across the whole lake just to show the swans it could. The swans have been practising ever since.

frog.lore.epic: Jumped into the garden pond so hard that every goldfish ended up in the birdbath.

x_toad_creature.lore.legendary: Lived under the same flowerpot for forty years, and the house has been sold three times with the toad listed as a fixture.
x_toad_creature.lore.uncommon: Sheds its skin once a week and eats it straight away, because it hates leaving a mess on the patio.

ladybug.lore.legendary: Hid under the window frame with ten thousand cousins for winter, and the house turned red every time someone opened the curtains.
ladybug.lore.epic: Played dead on a picnic blanket and left a yellow smelly drop on the sandwich. Nobody ate the sandwich.

i_agama.lore.epic: Climbed onto the village water tower to sunbathe, and its orange head glowed so brightly that the traffic stopped as if for a red light.
i_agama.lore.legendary: Did push-ups at its own reflection in a parked car for a whole afternoon, and the car alarm finally gave up.

i_alligator_lizard.lore.epic: Moved into the greenhouse and ate every slug inside, and the tomatoes grew so big the gardener needed a wheelbarrow.
i_alligator_lizard.lore.legendary: Bit its own tail and held on so tightly that it rolled down the hill like a scaly hoop.

i_american_alligator.lore.epic: Sat in the middle of the golf course for a whole day, and every golfer agreed that hole had been cancelled.

i_american_chameleon.lore.epic: Turned brown in fright on a chocolate cake and was nearly served at a birthday party.

i_common_newt.lore.legendary: Spent the whole winter asleep under a flowerpot, then walked back to the same pond in spring without once looking at a map.
i_common_newt.lore.epic: Moved into the garden water butt with a hundred friends, and every watering can came out with a newt in it.

i_eft.lore.epic: Walked into a family picnic so bright orange that a toddler tried to eat it, then spat it straight out. The eft looked very pleased.
i_eft.lore.legendary: Wandered the woods for three whole years, chose a pond at last, and turned green and dull overnight. Says it is happy being boring now.

i_european_fire_salamander.lore.rare: Sprayed a bitter mist from its skin at a fox, and the fox has eaten only toast since.

i_frilled_lizard.lore.legendary: Ran across the whole outback on its back legs and beat a kangaroo to the waterhole. The kangaroo demanded a recount.

i_gila_monster.lore.legendary: Bit a cowboy boot and held on for a whole afternoon. The cowboy now walks with one boot that hisses.
i_gila_monster.lore.epic: Dug into the cooler at a desert campsite and ate every egg for the week. The campers had cereal three times a day.

i_green_lizard.lore.rare: Grabbed a wasp in its jaws, thought better of it, and spent the afternoon spitting politely into a flowerpot.
i_green_lizard.lore.uncommon: Grabs the end of a blade of grass in its mouth and pulls until it pings, just to hear the noise.

lizard.lore.epic: Dropped its tail on the patio during a barbecue, and the tail kept wiggling until the guests had all gone home.
lizard.lore.uncommon: Drops its tail when a cat pounces, and the cat spends the afternoon guarding a wiggling tail while the lizard eats its biscuits.

i_spotted_salamander.lore.epic: Hid under the garden decking with a hundred cousins, and the whole deck lifted a little every time it rained.

i_whiptail.lore.legendary: Its whole family are sisters, so at every family party it has to sit next to someone who looks exactly like itself.

i_flatworm.lore.epic: Glided up the side of the aquarium and across the lid, and the goldfish watched it leave the building.

i_nematode.lore.legendary: Lives in a single spoonful of soil with a million relatives, and still finds room to throw a birthday party for every one of them.

i_sea_cucumber.lore.legendary: Shot its insides out at a nosy crab, grew them all back by Tuesday, and now tells the story at every rockpool party.
i_sea_cucumber.lore.epic: Swept so much sand through itself that the bay turned bright white, and the tourists asked who had painted it.

i_sea_slug.lore.legendary: Ate a whole Portuguese man-of-war, kept every sting, and the jellyfish now swim the long way round its rock.

x_slug_creature.lore.legendary: Squeezed through a gap the width of a pencil into the fridge and spent the night in the butter. Nobody has used that butter since.
x_slug_creature.lore.epic: Slimed a silver path across every doorstep on the street, and the postman had to wear football boots.

snail.lore.legendary: Carried its house up the garden wall, over the roof and down the chimney, and moved into the kitchen without anyone lifting a box.

i_diamondback.lore.epic: Shed its skin on the ranch fence, and the cowboys hung it up as a party garland before they noticed.

x_rattlesnake.lore.legendary: Found a mouse in a pitch-dark barn by heat alone, and the farmer now borrows it to find his slippers at night.

x_garter_snake.lore.legendary: Sprayed its musk at a whole garden party, and the barbecue was moved to the next town.

i_green_mamba.lore.epic: Hung in a fruit tree so green and still that the farmer picked it with the mangoes. The basket was empty by the time he got home.

i_green_snake.lore.legendary: Ate so many crickets in one summer that the meadow went quiet at night, and the campers complained they could not sleep without the noise.

i_hognose_snake.lore.epic: Dug up every toad in the vegetable patch with its shovel nose, and the gardener thought the potatoes were hopping.

i_horned_viper.lore.epic: Rubbed its scales together to make a hiss like sizzling bacon, and the whole desert camp went looking for breakfast.

i_sidewinder.lore.rare: Shook its rattle under a dune so quietly that only the beetles heard it, and they all moved house.
i_sidewinder.lore.epic: Crossed the car park at noon without burning a scale, and every barefoot tourist asked for lessons.

i_indian_cobra.lore.legendary: Stood up so tall in the rice field that the scarecrow quit and went home.

i_king_snake.lore.epic: Copied the coral snake so well that the coral snakes started inviting it to family dinners.

i_ringneck_snake.lore.legendary: Flashed its orange corkscrew tail at a hawk so suddenly that the hawk flew into a washing line.

i_rock_python.lore.uncommon: Wraps itself round the warm water pipe in the barn, and the farmer has to ask nicely before every shower.

snake.lore.legendary: Shed its whole skin inside a zipped sleeping bag, and the camper woke up next to a snake made of tissue paper.

i_thunder_snake.lore.epic: Got mixed up in a bait box with the earthworms, and the fisherman spent all morning wondering why the fish kept laughing.

i_water_snake.lore.legendary: Swam into the garden pond, counted the goldfish, and left a polite note saying it would be back on Tuesday.

i_barn_spider.lore.legendary: Spun a web across the barn door so strong that the farmer's hat stayed hanging in it all winter, like a coat peg.

x_scorpion_arachnid.lore.epic: Glowed under the campers' torches so brightly that they used it as a nightlight, until it moved into the sleeping bag.

i_wolf_spider.lore.legendary: Stared down a torch beam on the lawn at night until the torch batteries ran out.

i_leatherback_turtle.lore.common: Swallows jellyfish whole, then burps so loudly underwater that the whales check their sonar.
i_leatherback_turtle.lore.epic: Paddled up the river by mistake and sat in the town fountain until the lifeguards drove it back to sea in a paddling pool.
i_leatherback_turtle.lore.legendary: Swam across the entire ocean and back to lay its eggs on the same beach where it hatched, and still complained that the sand had moved.

turtle.lore.legendary: Has lived for a hundred and fifty years and outlived four garden sheds, two ponds and a very confident hare.

x_alligator_toy.lore.legendary: Floated out of the bath, down the drain and out to sea, and came back in a fisherman's net a year later with a seagull feather in its mouth.
x_alligator_toy.lore.epic: Floated so menacingly in the paddling pool that every rubber duck in the garden capsized itself.

x_crocodile_toy.lore.legendary: Was lost behind the radiator for ten years and came out with a perfectly toasted grin, demanding its old spot on the bed.

x_dinosaur_toy.lore.epic: Got stuck in the vacuum cleaner and roared every time it was switched on, so the hallway has not been cleaned in a month.
x_dinosaur_toy.lore.legendary: Was buried in the sandpit by a toddler and dug up years later by the same toddler, now grown up, who screamed that they had found a real fossil.

x_aphid.lore.legendary: Dripped so much honeydew on one parked car that the owner needed a week to open the door, and the ants moved into the glovebox.

x_axolotl.lore.epic: Gulped down a whole worm so fast with its suction mouth that the worm is still asking what happened.

x_bearded_dragon.lore.epic: Escaped into the airing cupboard and ate every cricket in the house, and the family slept through a whole night for the first time in years.

x_beehive.lore.legendary: Sent out a swarm so big that it moved into the school bell tower, and the bell now buzzes at the end of every lesson.
x_beehive.lore.uncommon: Air-conditions itself on hot days by having every bee fan its wings at the door, and the neighbours have asked to borrow it.

x_honeycomb.lore.legendary: Was found in a sealed jar after a thousand years, and the honey inside was still good enough for toast.

x_chameleon_lizard.lore.epic: Sat on a tartan blanket and tried so hard to match it that it went home with a headache.
x_chameleon_lizard.lore.common: Grips the curtain rail with its plier feet and refuses to let go at bedtime.

x_chrysalis.lore.legendary: Hung under the car wing mirror all winter and travelled six hundred miles, then opened up in a completely different town.

x_cicada.lore.legendary: Sang so loudly in the town square that the ice-cream van, the school bell and the fire siren all gave up and went home.

x_cocoon.lore.legendary: Hatched into a moth in the middle of a wedding, flew out of the bride's bouquet and landed on the cake. The photographer got a promotion.

x_dinosaur.lore.legendary: Survived the end of the dinosaurs by hiding in a very deep cave, and came out to find that everyone had turned into chickens.

x_earwig.lore.legendary: Guarded its eggs under a stone all winter and licked every one clean daily, then told the babies to tidy their own rooms.

x_firefly.lore.legendary: Blinked so brightly in the forest that the lost hikers followed it all the way home, then it went straight back for its sandwich.

x_flea.lore.rare: Moved into the cat's collar and made it scratch so hard it rang its own bell all night.

x_fly.lore.uncommon: Throws up a tiny drop on your toast before eating it, because it has no teeth and no manners.

x_gnat.lore.epic: Followed a cyclist all the way up the hill, and he arrived at the top with a moustache he did not have before.

x_housefly.lore.common: Lands on the butter the moment the lid comes off, then walks off leaving footprints.

x_louse.lore.rare: Crawled from one head to another during story time, when two children leaned in to see the pictures. Nobody saw a thing.

x_monitor_lizard.lore.legendary: Swam out to a fishing boat, climbed aboard and ate all the bait, then sunbathed on the deck while the fisherman rowed it home.

x_newt.lore.common: Sits at the bottom of the pond for so long that the fish think it is an ornament.
x_newt.lore.rare: Shed its whole skin in one go and ate it, because nothing in the pond goes to waste.

x_praying_mantis.lore.uncommon: Sways gently from side to side like a leaf in the wind, even when there is no wind at all.
x_praying_mantis.lore.epic: Laid an egg case on the shed door that hatched two hundred tiny mantises, and the shed has been very well guarded ever since.

x_salamander.lore.legendary: Crawled into a wet boot by the back door and lived there all winter, and the boot was never worn again.

x_silverfish.lore.epic: Wriggled so fast across the bathroom tiles that the cat fell into the bath trying to catch it.

x_spider_egg.lore.legendary: Sent a thousand spiderlings floating off on silk threads, and one landed on the weather forecaster's nose live on TV.

x_stick_insect.lore.epic: Laid a hundred eggs that looked like seeds, and the gardener planted them all in a pot. The pot grew legs.

x_t_rex.lore.legendary: Was the biggest meat-eater the world had ever seen, and its fossil now has to share a museum hall with a pigeon.
x_t_rex.lore.epic: Roared so loudly at a volcano that the volcano went quiet for a thousand years, out of politeness.

x_termite.lore.legendary: Built a mound so big in the savannah that a giraffe used it as a scratching post and an elephant used it as a chair.

x_triceratops.lore.epic: Sat down on a fern meadow for lunch and squashed it so flat that the valley became a football pitch.
